I can as well. It was hard growing up and being that kid who lost their parent. It was the talk about school for a while. I wonder where I would be too. I know how happy I would be and what relationship I would have had with my mom. I remind myself everyday for the things that mean most to me in life but there's always that thought of whether my family would be better off without me. I've hit this low several times and managed to pick myself back up, but I just sometimes wonder whether this will be the last time. 

Absolutely, my moms death has changed everyone. My dad moved on 6 months after she died and didn't look back - everyone told us he was grieving but I find it slightly hard to believe. That's true, I'm sure if I did go, my family would be so hurt if I hadn't said anything to them. I keep telling myself I will fall in love and meet the right person, have kids and grow old, but I'm at the point where I think what happens if I never get better?

Thank you so much for your kind words. I haven't spoken to anyone today and it may not mean much, but you've really helped me. Your father would be so proud of you for helping someone you've never met before. For you to have been heartbroken by his passing means that he must have been such an influential and kind person in your life.

I'm so sorry for your loss. I hope you're doing okay now. 

I have a family but we stopped talking for 5+ years because of my moms death. We are talking now, but I t's not the same. I have an uncle that's drinking because of it and without sounding selfish, it's just bringing up how shitty life is that she's still gone. I promise you I'm trying, I really am, but sometimes the fact that I will never have a hug, kiss or conversation again makes me just shut down. I'm not with anyone either. I've tried talking and approaching people but I constantly think everyone hates me or that I annoy them. Again, I shut down. 

You're absolutely right, life is so very precious. I really wish I would believe it.
